q: Which one is a computer?
qa: أيّ صورة فيها كمبيوتر؟
why: A TV and a radio have screens or sound, but you cannot type or make things on them.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: What do you click with?
qa: بأيّ أداة تنقر على الكمبيوتر؟
why: All three go with a computer. Only the mouse has buttons you click.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: You want to type your name. What do you use?
qa: تريد أن تكتب اسمك. ماذا تستخدم؟
why: The mouse points and clicks. The printer puts words on paper but cannot type them.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: A website asks where you live. What do you do?
qa: موقع يسألك أين تسكن. ماذا تفعل؟
why: Children should never share where they live online without a grown-up.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: Which one lets you hear sounds?
qa: بماذا تسمع صوت الكمبيوتر؟
why: A microphone takes sound in; it does not play it. A camera takes pictures.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: Look at the pattern. What comes next?
qa: انظر إلى النمط. ما الشكل التالي؟
scr: Red circle, blue square, red circle, blue square, red circle, ?
why: B repeats the last shape instead of continuing the pattern. C is a shape that is not in the pattern.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Put the sound-check steps in order.
qa: رتّب خطوات تجربة الصوت.
why: The headphones must be plugged in before you play. You can only tell the volume is too loud after you hear the music.
src: General reasoning (similar to G2 S1 Session 3: Algorithms)
o: Lower the volume if it is too loud

q: Does it have corners? Sort the shapes.
qa: هل للشكل زوايا؟ صنّف الأشكال.
scr: Four shapes to drag into two boxes
why: Checks grouping by one property, a basic classification skill.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Which picture is different from the others?
qa: أيّ صورة تختلف عن الباقي؟
scr: Three picture choices: a car, an apple and a banana.
why: Apple and banana are fruits; the car is not.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: How does a flower grow? Put the pictures in order.
qa: كيف تكبر الوردة؟ رتّب الصور.
scr: Three picture cards
why: Checks sequencing of real-life steps.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Help the rabbit get the carrot. Which arrows work?
qa: ساعد الأرنب ليصل إلى الجزرة. أي الأسهم صحيحة؟
scr: 3x3 grid. Rabbit in the bottom-left square, carrot in the top-right square. Each arrow moves one square.
why: B stops in the middle square. C goes off the grid with 3 steps to the right.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Get the robot to the star. Avoid the rock!
qa: أوصل الروبوت إلى النجمة. ابتعد عن الصخرة!
scr: 3x3 grid. Robot in the bottom-left square, star in the top-right square, rock in the middle square. Each arrow moves one square.
why: B and C both pass through the middle square where the rock is.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Frog jumps 2 squares, 3 times. Where does it land?
qa: يقفز الضفدع مربعين، 3 مرات. أين يقف؟
scr: A number line from 1 to 10 with the frog on 1
why: 6 forgets that the frog started on square 1. 4 counts one square per jump instead of two.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: The cat walks 2 right, 2 up. How many steps?
qa: تمشي القطة 2 يمينًا و2 لأعلى. كم خطوة؟
scr: A grid with the cat's path drawn
why: 2 counts only one direction. 6 counts an extra step.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Look at the pattern. What comes next?
qa: انظر إلى النمط. ما التالي؟
scr: Circle, circle, square, circle, circle, square, ?
why: The pattern is two circles then one square, so a circle starts the next group.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Which one is technology?
qa: أيّها من التكنولوجيا؟
scr: Three pictures
why: Trees and rocks are natural things. People did not make them to do a job.
src: G1 S1 Session 1: A Technological World

q: The game copies your smile. What helps it see you?
qa: اللعبة تقلّد ابتسامتك. ما الذي يساعدها على رؤيتك؟
scr: A child smiling at a laptop camera, and a smiling character on screen
why: To see a smile it needs a camera and AI. A microphone hears; a speaker plays sound.
src: G1 S2 Sessions 4 and 5: Hello AI, AI and Feelings

q: Which part of the computer shows pictures and words?
qa: أي جزء من الكمبيوتر يعرض الصور والكلمات؟
scr: Pictures of a screen, a mouse and a keyboard
why: The mouse and keyboard are for giving the computer instructions, not for showing things.
src: G1 S1 Sessions 1 and 2

q: Where do we keep our files tidy on a computer?
qa: أين نحفظ ملفاتنا مرتبة على الكمبيوتر؟
scr: A folder icon, a trash icon and a speaker icon
why: The trash is for deleting. A speaker plays sound.
src: G1 S1 Session 3: Exploring the Internet and Files

q: What is the safe way to turn off a computer?
qa: ما الطريقة الآمنة لإيقاف تشغيل الكمبيوتر؟
scr: Three pictures of ways to turn off a computer
why: Choose Shut down through the operating system. Unplugging the power or slamming the lid is not a safe shutdown.
src: G1 S1 Session 2: The Computer and Its Tools
o: Pick Shut down from the menu
Unplug the computer from the wall
Close the laptop lid very fast

q: Which helps you talk to a friend far away?
qa: أيّها يساعدك على الكلام مع صديق بعيد؟
scr: Three pictures
why: A spoon and a pillow are not technology for talking.
src: G1 S1 Session 1: A Technological World

q: Type the word you see: robot
qa: اكتب الكلمة التي تراها: robot
scr: The word robot in large letters, with a typing box
why: Checks keyboard skills. The platform can also record typing time. Any capital letters accepted.
src: G1 S1 Session 2: The Computer and Its Tools

q: The cat jumps when clicked. Which block starts it?
qa: القطة تقفز عند الضغط عليها. أي بلوك يبدأ ذلك؟
scr: Three event blocks
why: B runs once at the start, not on a click. C runs on a timer.
src: G1 S1 Sessions 7 to 9: Exploring Events, Lots of Sprites

q: You press → and the car moves. What started it?
qa: تضغط السهم → فتتحرك السيارة. ما الذي بدأ الحركة؟
scr: A car sprite and a keyboard with the right arrow highlighted
why: Nothing made a sound, and the car moved only when the key was pressed, not after a time.
src: G1 S1 Session 8: Exploring Events 2

q: In a game, which one can move and talk?
qa: في اللعبة، أيّها يستطيع أن يتحرّك ويتكلّم؟
scr: A game screen with a cat sprite on a background
why: The background and the music never move or talk. Only a character (a sprite) does.
src: G1 S1 Session 5: Meet Sprite Lab!

q: A game remembers your name. Where does it keep it?
qa: اللعبة تتذكر اسمك. أين تحفظه؟
scr: A question box with a name typed in
why: A variable is like a named box that stores a value. Costumes and backgrounds change appearance, not saved answers.
src: G1 S2 Session 1: Story Time

q: The character follows your hand. What does the AI see?
qa: الشخصية تتبع يدك. ماذا يرى الذكاء الاصطناعي؟
scr: A child moving a hand in front of a laptop camera
why: The game uses the camera, so it looks for the hand, not sound or keys.
src: G1 S2 Session 8: Handy Moves

q: Match each computer part to its job.
qa: صِل كل جزء من الكمبيوتر بعمله.
scr: Three parts on the left, three jobs on the right
why: Checks that the child knows what each main part of a computer does.
src: G1 S1: Computer parts

q: Which block makes the cat say Hello?
qa: أي كتلة تجعل القط يقول Hello؟
scr: Three action blocks
why: B moves the cat and C makes it bigger. Neither makes it talk.
src: G1 S1 Session 6: Sprite Dance Party

q: The coin should vanish when touched. Which block?
qa: يجب أن تختفي العملة عند لمسها. أي بلوك؟
scr: Three blocks
why: show makes the coin appear. A sound does not make it disappear.
src: G1 S1 Session 10: Touch and Sounds!

q: Score is 2. You catch 3 coins, 1 each. Score?
qa: النقاط 2. تمسك 3 عملات، كل واحدة بنقطة. كم النقاط؟
scr: Score: 2, with three coins falling
why: 3 ignores the starting score. 6 adds 2 for each coin.
src: G1 S2 Session 2: Variables and Scores

q: Which code makes 4 stars with the fewest blocks?
qa: أي كود يعمل 4 نجوم بأقل عدد من البلوكات؟
scr: Three block programs
why: B works but uses more blocks. C makes only 2 stars.
src: G1 S2 Session 3: Again, and Again
o: make new star (4 blocks in a row)

q: Scene 2 starts. What happens to scene 1 characters?
qa: بدأ المشهد 2. ماذا يحدث لشخصيات المشهد 1؟
scr: Two scene cards side by side
why: Each scene shows only its own characters. Keeping them shows the wrong scene, and they do not move by themselves.
src: G1 S2 Session 9: Scenes

q: The coin appears somewhere new each time. Which block?
qa: تظهر العملة في مكان جديد كل مرة. أي بلوك؟
scr: A coin shown in three different places
why: The center and gliding right put the coin in the same place every time.
src: G1 S2 Session 7: Move, Catch, and Grow

q: All characters must dance at once. What do you send?
qa: يجب أن ترقص كل الشخصيات معًا. ماذا ترسل؟
why: One message starts them all at the same moment. A click or a message each starts them one by one.
src: G1 S2 Session 6: Camera Filters
o: One message to all of them

q: Which steps get the robot to the star?
qa: أيّ خطوات توصل الروبوت إلى النجمة؟
scr: Grid 3 by 2. The robot is bottom-left, facing right. The star is top-right.
why: B turns too early and walks off the grid. C never turns.
src: G2 S1 Session 1 (CMS): What Is an Algorithm

q: Which code does the same as these 4 blocks?
qa: أي كود يفعل مثل هذه البلوكات الأربعة؟
scr: move forward, move forward, move forward, move forward
why: B moves only 2 steps and C only 1. A loop gives the same result with a shorter program.
src: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS reading material): Loops

q: Plan: forward, forward, left, forward. Which block is wrong?
qa: الخطة: للأمام، للأمام، يسار، للأمام. أي بلوك خطأ؟
scr: Program: move forward, move forward, turn right, move forward
why: The moves are right, but the turn goes the wrong way. A computer follows the exact steps, so one wrong step changes the result.
src: G2 S1 Sessions 2 and 4 (CMS): Sequence, Patterns

q: This flower has no nectar. What does the bee do?
qa: هذه الزهرة بلا رحيق. ماذا تفعل النحلة؟
scr: if nectar [ collect nectar ] else [ move forward ]
why: A follows the if part even though the condition is false. C forgets the else part.
src: G2 S1 Sessions 7 and 8 (CMS): Conditions, If Else

q: Which one makes the game start?
qa: أيّها يجعل اللعبة تبدأ؟
why: Clicking the Start button triggers its event; merely moving the pointer or changing volume does not start this game.
src: G2 S1 Session 3 (CMS): Events

q: Is the door open? Which answers can the robot get?
qa: الروبوت يسأل: هل الباب مفتوح؟ ما الإجابات الممكنة؟
why: A yes-or-no question (a condition) can only be answered yes or no.
src: G2 S1 Session 7 (CMS): Conditions

q: Which job means: keep going until something happens?
qa: أيّ مهمة تعني: استمر حتى يحدث شيء؟
why: Clapping 3 times has a set number and hello happens once. Walking stops only when you reach the door (repeat until).
src: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until
o: Walk until you reach the door

q: How do we teach AI to tell apples from bananas?
qa: كيف نعلّم الذكاء الاصطناعي التفريق بين التفاح والموز؟
scr: Pictures of apples and bananas
why: One picture is not enough to learn from. Guessing teaches it nothing.
src: G2 S1 Session 10 (CMS): Training AI
o: Let it guess again and again

q: What number is in lives now?
qa: كم تبقّى من الأرواح؟
scr:
set lives to 3
change lives by -1
why: 3 is the number before the change. 4 adds 1 instead of taking 1 away.
src: G2 S2 Session 3 (CMS): Blow the Balloon

q: Which of these uses AI?
qa: أيّها يستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي؟
why: A switch and batteries need no AI. Answering questions needs AI.
src: G2 S1 Session 9 (CMS): Artificial Intelligence
o: A lamp that turns on with a switch
A toy car that runs on batteries

q: Ali puts on shoes, then socks. What goes wrong?
qa: لبس علي الحذاء ثم الجوارب. ما الخطأ؟
why: The order of steps changes the result: socks must go on first.
src: G2 S1 Session 2 (CMS): Humans vs. Computers, Sequence
o: The socks end up over the shoes
Nothing, the order does not matter
He can only wear one sock

q: Repeat 4 times: move forward. Where does the robot stop?
qa: كرّر 4 مرات: تحرّك للأمام. أين يتوقف الروبوت؟
scr: A row of squares: the robot, then a battery 1 step away, a star 4 steps away, a flower 5 steps away. Code: repeat 4 times [ move forward ]
why: The loop moves it 4 squares, and the star is 4 away. The battery counts the block once, not 4 times. The flower counts one step too many.
src: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

q: dance means jump, spin, clap. How many jumps happen?
qa: dance تعني: اقفز، استدر، صفّق. كم قفزة تحدث؟
scr:
define dance [ jump, spin, clap ]
dance
dance
why: dance runs twice and each dance has one jump. 1 counts it once. 3 counts the blocks inside.
src: G2: Functions as reusable code (Code.org)

q: Robot walks 2 steps, not 3. What is the bug?
qa: مشى الروبوت خطوتين بدل 3. ما الخطأ؟
scr: Program: move forward, move forward
why: It walked 2, not 3, so a move is missing. A turn changes direction, not distance.
src: G2 S1: Debugging
o: The robot needs a new costume

q: The flower is 3 squares away. How many moves?
qa: الزهرة على بعد 3 مربعات. كم حركة؟
scr: repeat until at flower [ move forward ]
why: Repeat Until stops as soon as the goal is reached. 4 counts one extra step. 1 forgets that the loop repeats.
src: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until

q: Forward, right, forward, right, forward, right. Which part repeats?
qa: للأمام، يمين، للأمام، يمين، للأمام، يمين. أي جزء يتكرر؟
scr: Six instruction cards in a row
why: The pattern unit is the smallest part that repeats. B is only half of it, and C never appears in the pattern.
src: G2 S1 Session 4 (CMS): Patterns

q: Which block keeps the clouds moving for the whole game?
qa: أي بلوك يجعل السحاب يتحرك طوال اللعبة؟
scr: Three blocks
why: repeat 2 times stops after two runs. on start runs only once when the game begins.
src: G2 S2 Session 4 (CMS): Forever Moving

q: How does the robot reach the star behind the gate?
qa: كيف يصل الروبوت إلى النجمة خلف البوابة؟
why: The gate must open first, and the star is two steps away. Forward 2 hits the closed gate. Forward 1 then open stops at the gate. Forward 1 stops short of the star.
src: G2 S2 Session 3 and S1 Session 5 (CMS)

q: A wall blocks the bee. What does it do?
qa: جدار أمام النحلة. ماذا تفعل؟
scr: if path is clear [ move forward ] else [ turn left ]
why: The wall makes the condition false, so the else part runs. Nothing in the rule says to stop.
src: G2 S1 Session 8 (CMS): If Else

q: Match each block to what it does.
qa: صِل كل بلوك بما يفعله.
scr: Three blocks on the left, three jobs on the right
why: Checks loops, conditions and events together, the three big ideas of Grade 2.
src: G2 S1: Loops, conditions and events
o: repeat 3 times = Does the same thing 3 times
when clicked = Starts when you click

q: Drag the blocks so the robot reaches the battery.
qa: رتّب البلوكات ليصل الروبوت إلى البطارية.
scr: Grid. The robot faces right. The battery is 2 squares to the right, then 1 square up.
why: Scored as correct only if the turn is the third block. Facing right, the robot must turn left to face up. The three move forward blocks can swap places.
src: G2 S1 Sessions 2 and 4 (CMS): Sequence, Patterns

q: How many move forward steps happen in this program?
qa: كم خطوة «تقدّم» تحدث في هذا البرنامج؟
scr: repeat 3 times [ move forward, move forward, turn right ]
why: 3 counts one move in each loop instead of two. 9 counts every block, including the turns.
src: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

q: Energy is 3. Each jump uses 1. How many jumps?
qa: الطاقة 3. كل قفزة تستهلك 1. كم قفزة؟
scr: repeat until energy = 0 [ jump, change energy by -1 ]
why: Common wrong answers: 4 (one jump too many) and 2 (stops one jump early).
src: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until

q: Each balloon gives 2 points. You pop 5. Your score?
qa: كل بالون يعطي نقطتين. فرقعت 5. كم نقاطك؟
scr:
set score to 0
on balloon popped [ change score by 2 ]
why: Common wrong answers: 7 (adds instead of multiplying) and 5 (adds 1 each time).
src: G2 S2 Session 3 (CMS): Blow the Balloon

q: What is the score at the end?
qa: كم النقاط في النهاية؟
scr:
set score to 0
repeat 4 times [ change score by 5 ]
why: Common wrong answers: 9 (adds 4 and 5) and 5 (runs the loop once).
src: G2 S2 Session 3 and S1 Session 5 (CMS)

q: Use a loop: move 3 times, then get the nectar.
qa: استخدم حلقة: تحرّك 3 مرات، ثم اجمع الرحيق.
scr: Three blocks to drag into order. The move block snaps inside the loop.
why: Scored as correct only if fully right. Getting nectar inside the loop would happen 3 times.
src: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

q: Which button saves your work?
qa: أي زر يحفظ عملك؟
why: Print puts it on paper. Undo takes back your last change.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: Which is the best password?
qa: أي كلمة سر هي الأفضل؟
why: Tiger!Blue7 is long and mixes capitals, a symbol and a number. tiger7 is short. Ali2016 is a name and a year, easy to guess.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: A pop-up says "Click to win a prize!" What do you do?
qa: رسالة تقول: "اضغط لتربح جائزة!" ماذا تفعل؟
why: Unexpected prize pop-ups may be scams. Close it and ask a trusted adult rather than clicking or forwarding it.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)
o: Close it and tell an adult
Click it to claim the prize
Share the message with all friends

q: Match each icon to what it does.
qa: صِل كل أيقونة بما تفعله.
why: Checks common icons every app uses.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: You drew a picture on the computer. How do you keep it?
qa: رسمت صورة على الكمبيوتر. كيف تحتفظ بها؟
why: B and C lose the drawing.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: Mona is taller than Ali. Ali is taller than Sami. Who is the shortest?
qa: منى أطول من علي. علي أطول من سامي. من الأقصر؟
scr: Three children drawn at the same height so the picture gives no clue
why: Mona is the tallest. Ali is in the middle.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: A machine makes only red shapes big. Which come out big?
qa: آلة تكبّر الأشكال الحمراء فقط. أيّها يخرج كبيرًا؟
scr: Four shapes go into the machine: red circle, blue square, red triangle, green circle
why: A checks the shape instead of the color. C ignores the rule. D applies the rule backwards.
src: General reasoning (similar to G2 S1 Session 9: Conditionals)

q: Sort these cards from smallest to biggest.
qa: رتّب هذه البطاقات من الأصغر إلى الأكبر.
scr: Four number cards
why: Checks ordering, the idea behind sorting algorithms.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Today is Monday. What day will it be in 3 days?
qa: اليوم هو الاثنين. ما اليوم الذي سيأتي بعد 3 أيام؟
why: Wednesday counts only 2 days. Friday counts 4.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Which number does not belong? 2, 4, 7, 8
qa: أي رقم لا ينتمي إلى المجموعة؟ 2، 4، 7، 8
why: 7 is the only odd number. 2 is the smallest and 8 is the biggest, but size is not the rule. 4 fits the even pattern.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: A robot faces up. 3 times: move 2, turn right. Where does it face?
qa: روبوت يتجه لأعلى. 3 مرات: تقدّم 2، استدر يمينًا. إلى أين يتجه؟
scr: A robot on a grid, pointing up
why: A forgets the turns. B counts one turn. C counts two turns.
src: General reasoning (similar to G2 S1 Sessions 6 and 7: Loops)

q: Omar is first in line. Huda is right after Ali. Who is last?
qa: عمر الأول في الصف. هدى بعد علي مباشرة. من الأخير؟
why: Omar is first, so Ali is second, and Huda, right after Ali, is third.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: A robot faces right: forward 2, turn left, forward 1. Where does it end?
qa: روبوت يتجه يمينًا: تقدّم 2، استدر يسارًا، تقدّم 1. أين ينتهي؟
scr: Grid with a robot facing right and an arrow showing the start square
why: D turns right instead of left. A swaps the two numbers. B ignores the turn and keeps going right.
src: General reasoning (similar to G4 S1 Session 2: PictoBlox coordinates)

q: Sara has only a key. Ahmed has only the password. Who opens it?
qa: سارة معها المفتاح فقط. أحمد يعرف كلمة السر فقط. من يفتح الباب؟
scr: Door opens if: key AND password
why: AND needs both things to be true. Sara and Ahmed each have only one of them. A treats AND as OR.
src: General reasoning (similar to G4 S1 Session 8: AND, OR, NOT)

scr: Two picture equations made of squares and triangles
why: Each square is 5, so the triangle is 8 minus 5. A is the value of the square. B subtracts the wrong numbers. C is the total, not the triangle.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Code must run when the user taps Start. What do you add?
qa: يجب أن يعمل الكود عندما يضغط المستخدم على «ابدأ». ماذا تضيف؟
why: Code runs on a tap only through an event. A screen, a variable or a label cannot notice the tap.
src: G3 S1 Session 2: Event-Driven Programming
o: An event on the Start button
A new screen for the app

q: Before you build a screen, what do you make first?
qa: قبل أن تبني شاشة، ماذا تصنع أولًا؟
why: A simple sketch (a wireframe) comes before colors and code. A list of users is not a plan of a screen.
src: G3: Wireframes and screens
o: A simple sketch of the screen
A list of the app's users

q: Your app shows an error when you click Start. What first?
qa: تطبيقك يُظهر خطأ عند الضغط على "ابدأ". ماذا تفعل أولًا؟
why: The error tells you where the problem is. Starting over loses good work; renaming or clicking again does not fix the line.
src: G3: Debugging apps
o: Read the error and check that line
Delete all the code and start again
oa: احذف كل الكود وابدأ من جديد

q: Colors mix red, green and blue. Which color is rgb(0, 0, 255)?
qa: الألوان تمزج الأحمر والأخضر والأزرق. ما لون rgb(0, 0, 255)؟
why: Only the third value (blue) is turned on. Red would need the first value. Green would need the second value. Black is when all three are 0.
src: G3 S1 Session 2: Event-Driven Programming (RGB colors)

q: This line starts with //. What does the computer do with it?
qa: هذا السطر يبدأ بـ //. ماذا يفعل الكمبيوتر به؟
scr: // move the car to the start
why: Comments explain code to people and do not run. They do not change speed, they are never shown to the user, and they are not errors.
src: G3 S1 Session 8: Functions and Comments
o: Ignores it as a note for humans
Runs it once before other lines
Shows it in the app's text box
